loss_definition.CE_quarter: -0.25 sum_j p_j log(q_j), no new labels or parameters

hypothesis: Changing the conditional risk center while holding inputs, architecture and realized LR path fixed may reduce shape/tail attenuation. Existing training as well as validation shapes are attenuated; this is evidence to test the loss, not proof that H2 is the cause.
comparison_scope: Finite-budget loss replacement under the current H2-derived schedule and stop-H selection. CE/4 matches local second-order loss scale near p=q, not AdamW/clip dynamics or global gradient scale. Negative results do not establish CE has no useful optimum.
checkpoint_selection: Epoch0 eligible; update only when stop group-macro H < selected best - 1e-5. Run all 134 epochs for both arms; no independent plateau triggers or early stop. Evaluation never chooses epoch or LR.
new_recording: Each epoch online loss, same stop H/CDF/edge plus common unscaled CE with explicit 1e-30 floor-count diagnostic, gradient norm/clip fraction, batch/RNG digests. Selected best train/stop/evaluation predictions with dropout off; no invented prior trajectories. Monitor CE trajectory and endpoint best to disclose H-based schedule/selection limitations.
evaluation: Reuse frozen whole-distribution H/CDF/edge, raw Q50/IQR/Bowley errors, absolute Bowley TP/FP/FN and fixed 1% unique-T budget retrieval. Report both tail bias and absolute error. Same oracle and training-only constant centers. No threshold tuning.

promotion_rule.necessary_primary_improvement: Within the pre-existing raw strong-shape union (IQR>=1 and abs(Bowley)>=0.30), at least 10% lower group-macro Bowley AE OR at least 20% lower magnitude of whole-cohort negative open-tail bias together with lower negative-tail absolute error, on both stop and evaluation. Report each sign and training performance separately; do not substitute whole-cohort average Bowley error for this rare-shape condition.
promotion_rule.guardrails: Overall H and CDF MSE each no more than 1% worse on stop and evaluation; no decrease in summed negative-plus-positive fixed-budget true positives on either partition. Rare-event counts remain descriptive, not significance claims.
promotion_rule.if_passed: At most one further fold/seed paired confirmation under an independently frozen existing H2 schedule. No new architecture or hyperparameter search.
promotion_rule.if_failed: Do not tune CE weight/LR/threshold to rescue it. Retain H2 engineering baseline; use effect pattern and controls to narrow the mechanism claim.

preflight: Fresh cache/release/source hash check; guard before target reads; available GPU at least 18GiB and no competing compute process; MemAvailable at least 320GiB; no production CPU change.
